summary: It is now clear how to prove mail works, and old failures no longer linger on the Overview.

fixes.title: Clear steps to prove mail works
fixes.text: The permission banner now points to Settings > Mail & alerting > Send test alert, which needs at least one alert recipient.

fixes.title: Environment name card easy to find
fixes.text: It is now the first card under Settings > Naming & accounts.

fixes.title: Old failures are cleared
fixes.text: The Overview no longer shows failures from an earlier run after every definition was removed.
